description: The Central Statistical Office (CSO) of Saint Lucia links its 2022 Population and Housing Census results to a REDATAM database on the ECLAC-CELADE webserver. The household file records building type, roof and wall materials, building period, water supply, whether that supply is continuous, drinking water, toilet type, source of lighting and cooking fuel, as well as whether electricity, water, landline, cable and internet are included in rent, dwelling insurance and a count of unmet basic needs. The geography nests districts, enumeration districts and building blocks, so tables can be run for small areas in the browser. Earlier censuses from 1991, 2001 and 2010 are also listed on the REDATAM directory. Format and access: free online frequencies, cross tabulations and area lists without registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the ECLAC directory labels the 2022 base as preliminary results, and the household file carries a weight, so counts may be estimates. Simulation uses: enumeration district counts of intermittent water supply for network reliability studies, and roof and wall types for hurricane exposure. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub and the Saint Vincent and the Grenadines census record.

Household variables include building type, dwelling insurance, ownership, rent and utilities included in rent (electricity, water, landline, cable, internet), land arrangement, roofing, walls, building period, water supply, continuity of water supply, drinking water, toilet and sharing, lighting, cooking fuel, rooms, vehicles, household weight and number of unmet basic needs
